title: Repair CI quality and policy-foundation failures after Vault private-delivery design
expected_outcome: CI Quality and Policy Foundation have a minimally repaired, locally verified contract without weakening policy enforcement or changing Vault, cloud, or secret state.
constraints: Preserve policy semantics and narrow any test adjustment to the observed regression.
Do not apply Terraform, access EKS or Vault, alter secrets, deploy, publish, merge, or change workflow permissions.

external_actions: commit and push the CI repair branch
create a pull request solely to trigger and observe CI Quality and Policy Foundation

primary_owner.responsibility: security-test semantics, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: a policy weakening, permission change, or external mutation is proposed
